It functions as the mandatory attribution/notification for users and must be preserved in every distributed copy unless all references to Project Gutenberg are removed in accordance with 1.C.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value of eyewitness memoirs (editorial introduction guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: A memoir's chief value is in 'putting down what he saw with his own eyes, what he heard with his own ears'—the eyewitness, contemporaneous account gives authenticity and importance to memoirs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor praises plain, unvarnished eyewitness reporting; when producing or evaluating memoirs, prioritize direct observation and first-hand testimony over second-hand reconstructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memoir tone and style guidance (editorial introduction)
rubrics_metrics.description: When relating one's own exploits, use simple, direct, and factual language; avoid self-glorifying purple passages. Enthusiastic or rhapsodic language is more acceptable when praising the exploits of others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editor notes that modesty and plain statement of facts are virtues in memoir writing; excessive grandiloquence about one's own deeds is an anti-pattern, though generous admiration of others is permissible.
